description: This line plot compares the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of four different model architectures as a function of the activated parameters ratio, presented as a percentage on the x-axis which ranges from 100% down to 25% with tick labels at intervals of 25%. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, scaled linearly from approximately 11.5 to 14.0. The four architectures are distinguished by line style and marker: the “Transformer” is shown as a dashed brown line with no markers; “Only MoHD FFN” is a grey dashed line with square markers; “Only MoHD ATTN” is a dark blue line with circle markers; and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” is a blue line with cross markers. At an activated parameters ratio of 100%, all four models have an Eval PPL value of approximately 11.5. As the ratio decreases to 75%, the Eval PPL for “Only MoHD FFN” increases slightly to about 11.6, while “Only MoHD ATTN” and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” both rise to approximately 11.6 and 11.7 respectively. At 50%, “Only MoHD FFN” drops to about 11.4, “Only MoHD ATTN” rises to about 12.1, and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” rises to about 12.0. At the lowest ratio of 25%, “Only MoHD FFN” increases to about 11.7, “Only MoHD ATTN” rises sharply to about 13.8, and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” rises to about 13.1. The “Transformer” model remains constant at an Eval PPL of approximately 11.5 across the entire range.
